title: claims
description: out/claims.json — what the extractor found, numbered in reading order, before anything was judged. Written by `papertrace extract` (which `run` calls before resolving references, so a claims limit can retrieve only what the selected claims cite) and read back by `check`, so the numbers a selection refers to hold still between retrieval and judging. It carries NO verdicts: a verdict field here would be a finding nobody made.

manuscript_sha256.description: sha256 of the manuscript this list was extracted from, copied from the manuscript slot's source map. `check` reuses the list only when it matches the slot's current hash; null (an unhashed source map) is never a match.

extractor.description: The model that produced the list, in the form `claude -p · <model>`.

claims.description: Citation-backed claims in reading order, ids from 1. Exactly the fields extraction produces — see results.schema.json for what each means.

truncated.description: The extraction's own cuts, keyed like results.json's `truncated` ('manuscript', 'citation contexts'). Carried into the run that judges these claims.
